newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND BEAT MEXICO 2-0 IN FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND BEAT MEXICO 2-0 IN FRIENDLY.

text.p: England beat Mexico 2-0 (halftime 1-0) in a friendly at Wembley on Saturday.
Scorers - Teddy Sheringham pen 18, Robbie Fowler 54

England - 1-David James; 2-Martin Keown, 3-Stuart Pearce, 4-David Batty (15-Jamie Redknapp 53), 5-Gareth Southgate, 6-Graeme Le Saux, 7-Robert Lee, 8-Paul Ince (captain), 9-Robbie Fowler, 10-Teddy Sheringham (17-Ian Wright 37), 11-Steve McManaman (16- Nicky Butt 68)

Mexico: 25-Aldolfo Rios (1-Hugo Pineda 58); 13-Pavel Pardo, 2-Claudio Suarez, 5-Duilio Davino, 7-Ramon Ramirez, 16-Alberto Coyote (20-Nicolas Ramirez 66), 18-Enrique Alfaro, 17-Benjamin Galindo (6-Marcelino Bernal 56), 8-Alberto Garcia Aspe (captain), 27-Carlos Hermosillo (15-Luis Hernandez 45), 11-Luis Roberto Alves (19-Ricardo Pelaez 45)
